mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS rising together fails to produce positive 60-day returns in > 40% of cases, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, prompting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in potential monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 0.2pp monthly rise), or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the stagflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3% and GDPC1 growth < 1% in the last quarter), the S&P 500 tends to have negative 20-day returns due to the Fed's dilemma between inflation and growth, leading to reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 40% of stagflation regime instances, or Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly job growth (PAYEMS) consistently signals a healthy labor market, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings are supported.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS over the last 3 years is below 0.03, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS growth is above 100k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 1.5 percentage points over three months signals a manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in potential recessionary risks.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO falls > 1.5pp in 3 months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts (HOUST) and real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates strong economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and GDPC1 rising together fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 40% of cases, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
